stories.title: Study finds Grok API backs Republicans, OpenAI API backs Democrats
stories.summary: A Convovo study queried SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7 and OpenAI’s GPT‑6.1 Sol through their developer APIs, asking each model to name a single candidate for upcoming midterm races without hedging. Grok recommended the Republican candidate in 92 % of responses, while GPT‑6.1 Sol chose the Democrat in 97 % of cases, and the two models agreed on less than 10 % of nearly 500 races. Consumer‑facing apps declined to answer, and OpenAI said the API results do not reflect typical ChatGPT behavior.
stories.why: The findings highlight potential partisan bias in AI model APIs, which could influence developers’ products and public trust in automated political advice.
